odia: କହିଲେ କୁଳକୁଟୁମ୍ଭଙ୍କୁ ଲାଜ, ନ କହିଲେ କୁଳ ଭାସି ୟାଉଛି
title: The cost of speaking, the cost of silence
literal_meaning: If I speak, the family is ashamed; if I do not, the family is being swept away.
explanation: Both choices carry a cost. Speaking exposes something embarrassing; remaining silent allows the damage to grow. The image of a family being swept away makes silence seem less safe than it first appears. The saying voices a dilemma, not a command to conceal wrongdoing for the sake of reputation.
meaning_odia: କହିଲେ ପରିବାରର ଲାଜ, ନକହିଲେ ପରିବାରର କ୍ଷତି—ଦୁଇ ପଟେ ଚିନ୍ତା। ଚୁପ୍ ରହିଲେ ମାନ ରହିଯିବ ବୋଲି ଲାଗିପାରେ, ହେଲେ ଭିତରର ଅସୁବିଧା ବଢ଼ୁଥାଏ। କୁଳ ଭାସିଯିବାର ଛବି ସେହି ବିପଦକୁ ତୀବ୍ର କରେ। ଏହା ଦ୍ୱିଧାର କଥା; ପରିବାରର ନାମ ପାଇଁ ଭୁଲ ବା ଅନ୍ୟାୟ ଲୁଚାଇବାର ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦେଶ ନୁହେଁ।
english_summary: Protecting a family’s reputation by silence may allow its troubles to deepen.
odia_summary: ପରିବାରର ଲାଜ ବଞ୍ଚାଇବାକୁ ଚୁପ୍ ରହିଲେ କ୍ଷତି ବଢ଼ିପାରେ।
usage_example: A family member discovers mounting unpaid bills and uses the saying while deciding how to begin an uncomfortable but necessary conversation. (Original imagined example, not collected testimony.)
cultural_context: Source defines family and gives the complete dilemma; the bills example is new. No particular household, historical event or duty to hide harm is asserted.
